meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-national tax distinctions)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law, French Civil Law, and Indigenous Customary Law unified under the Constitution of 1980 and modified by parliamentary statute)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Australia-Vanuatu Double Taxation Agreement (in force; limited scope covering profits from international air transport and shipping, with request-based exchange of information)
United Kingdom-Vanuatu Double Taxation Arrangement (in force from 13 December 2018; limited scope covering ship and aircraft operations and exchange of information)
New Zealand-Vanuatu taxation and exchange-of-information arrangement (in force; limited scope for international transport profits and information exchange)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER-Plus), in force since 13 December 2020 - plurilateral trade and economic integration agreement with Australia and New Zealand
European Union-Vanuatu Interim Economic Partnership Agreement (iEPA), provisionally applied since 2009 - duty-free and quota-free trade in goods
Agreement Establishing the World Trade Organization (Vanuatu acceded 24 August 2012)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap 222], as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act No. 7 of 2014 (UBO register) and subsequent amendments; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 1 of 2016, as amended by Acts No. 24 of 2017 and No. 20 of 2019; Financial Services Commission Act No. 34 of 1993 (establishing the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission); Financial Intelligence Unit Act No. 2 of 2016 (establishing the Vanuatu FIU); International Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2017; Proceeds of Crime Act [Cap 270]; Financial Dealers (Licensing) Act, as amended (licensing of registered agents); VFSC AML/CFT Code of Practice for International Companies
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (confidential central UBO register maintained by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission; not open to public inspection; accessible to the Vanuatu FIU, VFSC, domestic and international law-enforcement and tax authorities upon lawful request, and to covered persons under customer due diligence obligations)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization - Vanuatu is not a Contracting State to the Hague Apostille Convention; export copies must be notarized and legalized through the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs and/or the destination-country consular post

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association (constating documents) - notarized certified copy
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Vanuatu notary public / registered agent (with VFSC-issued incorporation record)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (notarization followed by chain legalization through the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs and/or the relevant foreign consulate; Apostille route not available in Vanuatu)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (solvency and compliance certificate)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Hague Apostille inapplicable for Vanuatu-issued documents)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified extracts of the register of directors and register of members (shareholders)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed VFSC registered agent (with VFSC-confirmed filing records)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization via Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs and destination-country consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Beneficial Ownership Declaration and UBO register extract (confidential statutory filing)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed VFSC registered agent (submitted to the VFSC central UBO register under the International Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2017)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization only for banking-pack certification; the underlying VFSC register record is Government_Only_Access

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police clearance / criminal record certificate of each director, shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner (natural persons)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Vanuatu Police Force (Criminal Records Office) or, for foreign residents, the relevant overseas competent authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if issued overseas in a Hague Contracting State) or Consular Legalization (if issued in Vanuatu or in a non-Hague state)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based customer due diligence under the Vanuatu AML/CFT Act 2016 before any International Company registration. All proposed directors, shareholders, UBOs, authorized signatories and the corporate secretary are screened at incorporation against: (i) the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list; (ii) the US OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists; (iii) the UK HM Treasury consolidated financial sanctions list; (iv) the Australian DFAT consolidated sanctions and autonomous sanctions lists; (v) the EU consolidated sanctions list; and (vi) Vanuatu FIU/VFSC domestic freezes and advisories. PEP exposure, foreign or domestic, triggers enhanced due diligence requiring senior management approval, documented source-of-wealth and source-of-funds evidence, and ongoing transaction monitoring. Adverse-media and negative-news screening is applied. The registered agent must retain all screening and CDD records for a minimum of five years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Online Company Search and Name Reservation - VFSC e-Registry (accessible at vfsc.vu; statutory filings effected through a licensed VFSC registered agent appointed under the International Companies Act)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be in Latin script and may be expressed in English, French or Bislama, with optional numerals and punctuation. The statute requires a corporate designator suffix such as 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Incorporated', 'Inc', 'Société Anonyme', 'SA', or an equivalent recognized in the permitted languages. No Bislama transliteration is mandated. The proposed name must not be identical, phonetically equivalent, or misleadingly similar to any name already on the VFSC register, and must not, in the Registrar's opinion, suggest patronage, sponsorship, or connection with the Government of Vanuatu or any public authority.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the licensed registered agent files a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of International Companies at the VFSC within 14 calendar days of the notice of refusal, submitting a corrected name or written submissions on non-conflict and non-deception. The Registrar must issue a determination within 21 working days. An unsuccessful appellant may, within 30 days, seek review by the Vanuatu Supreme Court on a point of law under the International Companies Act. Same-day re-submission of a modified name variant is expressly permitted and incurs only the standard reservation fee, which is waived if the original fee credit is used within the 30-day reservation window.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for the statutory registered office. Every International Company must at all times maintain a registered office in Vanuatu at a physical commercial address in Port Vila or Luganville occupied by a VFSC-licensed registered agent. A remote or virtual-office arrangement may not substitute for the agent's physical office. The IC's underlying manufacturing and trading business may, however, be conducted entirely outside Vanuatu, and no local operational premises or employees are required in the jurisdiction.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified annual risk: 10-15% that the licensed registered agent's premises undergo a VFSC AML/CFT compliance inspection or unannounced verification visit; less than 2% risk of any on-site inspection at the IC's operational premises because International Companies are statutorily prohibited from carrying on business in Vanuatu and generally maintain no physical site in the country; destination-market medical-device regulators may audit the manufacturing site situated outside Vanuatu under the applicable product conformity regime, but that audit sits outside the Vanuatu corporate-law inspection perimeter.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222] of Vanuatu, as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2013, principally sections 3 (incorporation), 4 (memorandum), 5 (articles), 8 (directors), 9 (secretary), 10 (registered office and registered agent), and 14 (register of members).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of an International Company (Form IC-1), together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; shares may be of no par value, denominated in any currency, and fully paid for by any lawful consideration agreed in the memorandum; no statutory escrow account or capital deposit is required on incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscribers named in the Memorandum and Articles of Association take up the shares allotted to their respective names, for no-par-value shares, consideration being deemed lawfully satisfied, and the register of members be opened. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office be fixed at the offices of the Company's licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, who is authorized to accept service of process. RESOLVED FURTHER that [Name] as Director, [Name] as Company Secretary, and [Name] as Principal Officer be appointed until otherwise determined by the Board, each having consented, and the Secretary be directed to file all necessary notices with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Companies Registry, acting through a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request in English through a licensed registered agent. The agent verifies availability against the national register of international companies and the general companies register. The proposed name must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing entity and must end with 'Limited' or an approved suffix. Once cleared, the name is reserved for up to 90 days.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application prepared by the registered agent
Passport copy or certificate of identity of the proposed beneficial owner for agent KYC
Completed due diligence questionnaire of the applicant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity or prohibited character, the agent re-files with up to three alternative names at no additional government search fee. If the reservation lapses, a fresh reservation application is lodged.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutive Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-Licensed Registered Agent and a notary public or attorney-at-law in Vanuatu.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association in compliance with the International Companies Act. Each subscriber subscribes for at least one share and signs the memorandum in the presence of the agent or a notary. The articles adopt a broad objects clause permitted for international companies. Written consents of the proposed director, secretary, and principal officer are obtained and annexed.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum of Association
Executed Articles of Association
Subscriber consent forms and KYC pack
Consent to act as director
Consent to act as company secretary
Registered agent engagement letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC flags defective drafting or missing statutory clauses, the agent amends the documents and re-executes the signature pages before submission. No additional government fee is charged where the amendment is made prior to registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission and Registration with the VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - International Companies Registry, Port Vila.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Application for Registration, certified copy of the constitutional documents, and the registered agent's consent with the VFSC. Pay the government registration fee and applicable stamp duties. Standard processing is five business days; expedited 24-hour or same-day service is available for an additional fee. Upon approval, the VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation dated the day of registration.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 Application for Registration
Certified copy of Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent of licensed registered agent
Corporate and individual KYC documentation
Government fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC issues a requisition for further information or rejects the application, respond in writing within 14 days through the registered agent. Clerical defects are cured by filing an amendment form. If rejection persists, a formal appeal may be made to the VFSC under the International Companies Act, or the application may be re-filed with corrected documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Statutory Registers and Post-Incorporation Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent and Company Board, with VFSC notification where required.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon receipt of the Certificate of Incorporation, the registered agent opens the statutory registers, including the register of members, register of directors, register of secretaries, register of charges, and minute book. These records are maintained at the registered office in Port Vila. Director and member particulars are kept confidential under the International Companies Act but must be available for lawful inspection by the agent and regulatory authorities.
required_dossiers: Original Certificate of Incorporation
Statutory register templates
Director and secretary particulars
Share allotment schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a statutory register is incomplete or the certificate is lost or defaced, prepare a notarized declaration and apply to the VFSC for a replacement certificate; rectify register entries before the next annual return filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Adoption of Corporate Governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the International Company.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or circulate a written resolution in lieu of meeting. Adopt the pro-forma first board resolution covering the subscription of shares, adoption of the registered office at the agent's address, appointment of the director, company secretary, and principal officer, authorization to open bank accounts, and adoption of the corporate seal. Record the minutes in the minute book and retain executed consents.
required_dossiers: Pro-forma first board resolution
Executed consents to act of officers
Minute book or written resolution record
Bank account opening forms if authorized
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an officer declines appointment or a director becomes disqualified, the Board passes a replacement resolution and records the change. If VFSC notification is required, the registered agent files an officer change notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business Licence, Investment Approval, and Zoning Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) - Business Licence Division, in coordination with the Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism and Commerce.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a Business Licence under the Business Licence Act [Cap 14] through the VIPA online portal for the activity 'Manufacture of hollow-fiber polyethersulfone dialysis consumables (ISIC 3250)'. If the beneficial owners are non-citizens, obtain the applicable Foreign Investment Approval Certificate. Secure municipal zoning confirmation from the Port Vila Municipality for the manufacturing plant site and submit the environmental and fire safety clearances referenced below.
required_dossiers: Business licence application form via VIPA online portal
Copy of Certificate of Incorporation
Lease or registered title deed of the manufacturing premises
Site plan and municipal zoning confirmation
Director and beneficial owner identification documents
Fire safety and environmental clearances issued pre-issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Business Licence is refused due to incomplete environmental or zoning documentation, rectify the cited conditions and submit a written appeal to VIPA within 30 days of refusal. A temporary or conditional licence may be issued pending final clearances.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) - Business Licence Division, together with the Department of Industry of the Ministry of Trade, Tourism and Commerce.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence for Medical Device Manufacturing (Manufacturing Class), supplemented where applicable by a Foreign Investment Approval Certificate and a Port Vila Municipality trading/zoning permit.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Environment, Energy and Disaster Management, acting under the Environmental Management and Conservation Act No. 12 of 2002.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category A - Full EIA Report required for industrial manufacturing operations involving polymer extrusion, chemical use, sterilization, and process effluent discharge; a registration and environmental management plan may be accepted only for negligible-impact ancillary facilities.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater - discharge must comply with Vanuatu national water-quality standards and applicable WHO effluent guidelines for medical-device manufacturing, including pH 6-9, COD and total suspended solids limits, no visible oil sheen, and sterilization-agent residue limits (ethylene oxide and gamma-irradiation controls). Volatile organic compounds (VOCs) - fugitive emissions from polyethersulfone extrusion and potting solvents must be controlled via carbon adsorption or thermal oxidation to below DEPC-prescribed thresholds. Hazardous waste - polyethersulfone scrap, spent solvents, and glutaraldehyde or polyvinylpyrrolidone residues must be segregated, labeled, and disposed of through a licensed waste contractor with manifest records maintained for DEPC inspection.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services confirming occupancy load, means of egress, fire suppression systems, and safe storage of flammable solvents; structural load inspection certificate from the Public Works Department confirming floor-load capacity for extrusion, potting, and sterilization equipment; and workplace clearance / OHS compliance certificate from the Department of Labour covering ventilation, machine guarding, ergonomics, and employee medical-surveillance protocols for the dialysis filter manufacturing line.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department (VIRD), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; online portal: https://vrevenue.gov.vu (domestic taxes) and https://vfsc.vu (International Company registration)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Vanuatu International Company (VU_IC) is exempt from income tax and does not receive a national TIN solely for incorporation. If the IC conducts taxable local supplies, it must apply to VIRD for VAT registration using Form VAT-01, submitting the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation, Articles of Association, registered agent certificate, passport copies of directors, local registered address, and estimated annual taxable turnover. VIRD verifies the application and issues a VAT identification number. If the IC remains wholly offshore and does not make taxable supplies in Vanuatu, no TIN or VAT ID is required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No income tax law exists in Vanuatu, therefore no check-the-box, CFC, hybrid mismatch, or partnership tax election is applicable. Under the Value Added Tax Act, a VAT-registered person may elect the annual accounting scheme instead of the standard bi-monthly return cycle, and affiliated taxable persons may apply to VIRD for VAT grouping. An International Company may elect to remain non-resident and offshore by transacting exclusively outside Vanuatu.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Vanuatu Value Added Tax Act [Cap. 293]
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 4,000,000 (approximately USD 35,000) estimated or actual taxable turnover in any 12-month period; voluntary registration is permitted below this threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing API, digital stamping, or invoice clearance mandate is currently implemented in Vanuatu. Taxpayers may use any standard commercial invoicing system, but must issue prescribed two-copy VAT invoices for taxable supplies exceeding VT 2,000 and retain all records, including supplier invoices and export evidence, for at least 5 years.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to the export of physical goods, including medical devices and dialysis consumables, where the supplier exports the goods outside Vanuatu in the course of business and retains proof of export. Services supplied to a non-resident relating to exported goods or performed wholly outside Vanuatu may also qualify. The exporter must make the supply to an overseas customer, remove the goods physically from Vanuatu, and hold contemporaneous documentary evidence of export and foreign payment.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Original VAT invoice issued by the exporter
Contract or purchase order evidencing the export sale
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VIRD may audit export zero-rating and input VAT refund claims. If the required export documentation is not produced within 180 days, or if the declaration is false, the zero-rating is clawed back and VAT is assessed at the standard 15% rate. Supplementary penalties range from 100% of the tax for non-fraudulent errors to 150% for fraud; monetary fines up to VT 1,000,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years apply to deliberate fraudulent export claims. Directors and responsible officers may be personally liable under the Value Added Tax Act.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) — the central bank under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act, with sole monetary authority and prudential supervision of all licensed banks and domestic clearing infrastructure; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) administers the International Company registry and non-bank licensing, whereas FX and capital-movement policy is executed through the RBV.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: De jure and de facto convertibility of the vatu on both current and capital account: Vanuatu operates no exchange-control legislation, no central-bank approval or licensing requirement for capital inflows or outflows, and no restriction on profit, dividend, interest, or royalty remittances by tax-exempt International Companies; the VUV floats freely. Practical friction is limited to commercial-bank CDD and source-of-funds verification, and to the thin offshore depth of VUV; the treasury blueprint therefore designates USD as the functional currency and uses EUR only for procurement-linked hedging.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None applicable: Vanuatu imposes no statutory export-proceeds surrender obligation, no mandatory conversion ratio into VUV, and no export-invoice matching or currency-verification regime. A Vanuatu International Company may retain 100% of dialysis-filter trade proceeds in USD or any freely convertible currency in a designated RBV-licensed account; the only continuing obligation is to retain underlying invoices, transport documents, and MT103 payment records for five years under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD/VUV Capital Escrow Account plus Operational Trade Settlement Account
Multi-currency Operational Account with dedicated LC/Import Settlement sub-ledger
USD/VUV Operational Account and Commercial LC issuing line
Domestic VUV retail-denominated account only (non-core for IC treasury)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium viability: mainstream global EMIs (Wise Business, Airwallex, Payoneer) generally exclude Vanuatu-incorporated companies by jurisdiction policy, or impose severe velocity caps and whitelisted-counterparty rules; legally, an unlicensed offshore EMI may render foreign-currency payment-initiation services to a Vanuatu IC only as an ancillary technology service, and may not hold VUV deposits or solicit the Vanuatu public without RBV authorization. The settlement anchor must therefore remain an RBV-licensed bank, and any EMI may be used solely as a low-balance collection conduit for sub-threshold distributor receipts.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Not statutorily mandated under the International Companies Act Cap. 222; however, ANZ, Bred, and BSP uniformly require a live video-conference KYC interview with at least one executive director as a condition of onboarding, and reserve the right to request an in-person visit at Port Vila when preliminary CDD scoring is unsatisfactory. Fully remote documentary opening is granted only where the IC already benefits from an existing banking relationship with the same group elsewhere in the Pacific; directorial physical presence is otherwise dispensable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore International Company with no local physical footprint, payroll, or office at the moment of account opening (shell-company red flag).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Economic-substance file comprising: VFSC registered-agent certificate; board minutes appointing a Port Vila compliance liaison; exclusive contract-manufacturing agreement with an ISO 13485-certified overseas CMO; ISO 13485 and applicable product-marketing certificates in the IC's name for the PES hollow-fiber dialyzer; and an annual budget demonstrating third-party manufacturing and logistics expenditures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital injection above USD 500,000 from a shareholder personal account instead of a corporate treasury account, or from a third-country intermediary wallet.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-funds packet: audited or management financial statements of the parent; signed bank-issued Wealth Declaration; share-certificate entry in the IC's register; shareholder tax-residence certificate or income-tax return; six-month statements of the remitting account; and a confirmatory board resolution tracing the capital to declared trade or IPO proceeds in the dialysis consumables sector.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Repetitive outbound wires to Asia-Pacific suppliers bearing generic descriptors such as 'consulting' or 'management fees' that contradict the ISIC 3250 manufacturing scope.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Trade-disbursement discipline pack: every instruction must carry SWIFT purpose code GDS or PDST plus the purchase-order reference; supporting proforma invoice, CMO purchase order, and for wires above USD 20,000 a sight LC or documentary collection with independent pre-shipment inspection certificate; and a quarterly reconciliation of disbursements against the registered contract-manufacturing schedule.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO chain involving discretionary trusts or foundation layers that masks the natural-person ultimate owner during bank onboarding.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Constructive UBO disclosure: redacted but complete ownership chart mapping each layer to natural persons, consistent with the beneficial-ownership register introduced by the 2014 amendments to the International Companies Act; certified copy of the trust deed or foundation charter; updated letter of wishes; signed Control-and-Ownership form; and, where trust residency is foreign, a tax ruling or trustee undertaking confirming the IC's economic beneficiaries.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: SWIFT MT103 from the ultimate shareholder's corporate account to the IC's USD escrow or operating account at an RBV-licensed bank, using ISO 20022 purpose code EQUI (equity subscription) or INTC (intercompany shareholder loan) in field 70, together with the board resolution, share register certificate or signed loan agreement, and the bank's Source-of-Funds declaration; no RBV pre-approval is required, but credits approaching USD 100,000-equivalent are automatically risk-reviewed until the economic-substance file is complete, and all received funds should be parked natively in USD to avoid VUV conversion cost.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Two engineered rails: (1) Commercial Documentary LC via MT700 issued by the Vanuatu settlement bank in favor of the Taiwanese or Chinese CMO with the IC as applicant, with presentation of invoice, AWB or sea waybill, ISO 13485 Certificate of Conformity, certificate of origin, and independent inspection certificate, and reimbursement by MT103 against compliant presentation; (2) Open-account MT103 trade wires for repeat suppliers and low-value consumables under USD 20,000-50,000, each carrying SWIFT purpose code GDS or PDST with the PO number, proforma invoice, and packing list attached to the instruction; USD-denominated liquidity must be pre-funded in the operational account to avoid VUV FX drag.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forward (USD/EUR, USD/AUD, USD/VUV) with tenor up to 12 months under ISDA 1998 FX Annex or the Vanuatu bank's master FX agreement, collateralized by USD cash margin.
FX swap (tom/next or spot-forward roll) for temporary USD working-capital gaps in the trade cycle, consistent with RBV interbank FX guidelines.

Cross-currency swap (USD/EUR or USD/VUV) on a bespoke basis for facility tenors up to 24 months, executed with a global parent bank and mirrored through the Vanuatu settlement bank or its designated correspondent.

Non-deliverable forward (USD/VUV) available only via offshore booking at the parent bank in Sydney, Melbourne, or Auckland, as no onshore VUV NDF market exists; economically preferred for hedging EUR procurement liabilities into USD rather than VUV.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of International Company with payment of annual government maintenance fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 calendar month of each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of up to 100% of the applicable fee; continued non-filing for 3 months triggers VFSC administrative strike-off proceedings and loss of separate legal personality under the International Companies Act 1992

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Register annual confirmation and any update notifications
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) via registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Confirmation submitted together with the Annual Return; changes to beneficial ownership disclosed within 14 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No separate UBO filing fee; failure to maintain accurate UBO records or notify changes is a criminal offence under the Companies and Limited Partnerships (Beneficial Ownership) Act 2018, punishable by fines up to VT 1,000,000 and director disqualification

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None. Vanuatu International Companies are not required to undergo a statutory independent audit. An audit is only triggered voluntarily by the members (usually 25% or more of voting rights) or if the VFSC directs an examination of financial records under the International Companies Act 1992
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), as adopted by the Vanuatu Institute of Chartered Accountants; no submission of financial statements to VFSC is required

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must certify on the Annual Return that the Beneficial Ownership Register is accurate and current. Any change in shareholding or beneficial interest is notified to VFSC within 14 days; the Annual Return itself acts as the annual UBO confirmation instrument, and no separate UBO declaration fee is levied

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax on International Company (IC) income or gains derived from outside Vanuatu; ICs operate under a statutory tax-exempt-zone classification.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effective CIT rate is 0% for an IC that confines its dialysis-hemofilter manufacturing, extrusion, potting, and export sales to foreign-source operations. The IC is exempt from income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, stamp duty on its offshore transactions, and all recurrent municipal business taxes. The only recurring fiscal charge is the annual VFSC Government maintenance fee paid through the licensed Registered Agent. No payroll tax, social security levy, or net-worth tax applies. A domestic-source activity (e.g., selling devices inside Vanuatu) would be outside the IC exemption and would attract Business Licence Act (Cap 258) fees plus value added tax on taxable supplies.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return for International Companies (Form AR-IC), lodged through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Online Registry portal (www.vfsc.vu) exclusively by the IC's licensed Registered Agent. No corporate income tax return is filed in Vanuatu because IC exempt income sits outside the tax net; the annual return is a registry-compliance filing coupled with payment of the annual Government fee.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual — a single consolidated filing each anniversary of incorporation; Vanuatu imposes no quarterly provisional tax, no estimated tax, and no CIT instalment regime for International Companies.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within one calendar month (28 days) after the anniversary of the date of incorporation, which is the statutory filing anchor equivalent to a fiscal year-end for an IC. The IC may adopt any fiscal year for internal financial reporting, but the mandatory VFSC cycle is fixed to the incorporation anniversary.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The unique VFSC company number assigned at incorporation and shown on the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter exactly as registered; the non-resident owner does not file directly and must instruct the Registered Agent to verify the number against the VFSC corporate register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 / Company Name and Registered Agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The full legal name of the IC and the name and licence number of the VFSC-licensed Registered Agent in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders cannot self-represent; the appointed Vanuatu agent is the statutory filer and certification party for all registry submissions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The physical street address of the IC's registered office in Vanuatu, which must be the office of the Registered Agent or an address approved by the Registered Agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A post-office box alone is insufficient; this address is the legal seat for service of process and regulator correspondence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal names, residential addresses, nationalities, and shareholding percentages of all directors, members, and any nominee holders, updated to the anniversary date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident principal must disclose the ultimate beneficial owner to the Registered Agent; nominee arrangements must be evidenced by executed declarations retained in the agent's AML/CFT file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not carried on business with Vanuatu residents, held interests in Vanuatu land, or engaged in domestic trade requiring a Vanuatu Business Licence, and that its dialysis-device operations are executed offshore.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If manufacturing is physically located in Vanuatu, the IC structure is non-compliant; a separate domestic Vanuatu company would be required. The non-resident board must certify this position.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 / Compliance and Beneficial Ownership Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of AML/CFT compliance, maintenance of the underlying beneficial-ownership register, retention of accounting records, and, where applicable, economic substance documentation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Registered Agent signs the compliance declaration on behalf of the non-resident board; supporting records (board minutes, bank statements, sales contracts for dialysis hemofilters) must be held ready for VFSC inspection.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late lodgement of Form AR-IC attracts a fixed late-return penalty and a compounding daily surcharge while the default continues. Non-payment of the annual Government fee triggers loss of good standing and, after sustained default, compulsory strike-off of the IC from the VFSC register, with expensive restoration costs. Individual officers may also be liable to statutory fines for continuing non-compliance.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax, no branch remittance tax, and no distribution tax on an International Company paying dividends to non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable. Vanuatu does not maintain a network of comprehensive double taxation agreements (DTAs) applicable to IC dividend flows, and the Department of Finance and Treasury has no statutory function to issue a TRC in respect of exempt IC income. Dividends, sales proceeds, and management fees from the dialysis-hemofilter export business are remitted to non-resident shareholders gross through the IC's payment rails (Swift_LC and TT_Wire) without any Vanuatu deduction. A shareholder resident in a high-tax jurisdiction must obtain relief in its own residence state under domestic foreign-dividend or CFC rules; the only Vanuatu document available is a VFSC Certificate of Good Standing confirming the IC's exempt status and payment of annual fees.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties and licence fees paid by a Vanuatu IC to a non-resident IP holder for dialysis-dialyzer technology: 0% statutory WHT. Interest paid to non-resident lenders on cross-border debt (e.g., intra-group loans financing polyethersulfone fibre supply): 0% statutory WHT. No treaty rate applies because Vanuatu has no comprehensive income tax treaty network; the borrower-side deduction is equally nil, making Vanuatu a neutral conduit for repatriation.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None — Vanuatu has no codified transfer-pricing legislation, no Local File or Master File obligation, and no vatu-denominated documentation threshold for International Companies. Notwithstanding the absence of domestic TP law, the IC should maintain contemporaneous arm's-length documentation as a defensive record because related-party transactions with the offshore manufacturing affiliate will be scrutinised under foreign CFC, PFIC, and secondary-adjustment rules in the shareholder's residence jurisdiction.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu's Economic Substance Regulations (ESR), administered through VFSC, apply to entities carrying on specified geographically mobile relevant activities such as IP holding, headquarters, distribution and service centres, financing and leasing, banking, insurance, shipping, and pure-equity holding. The extrusion and potting of hollow-fibre polyethersulfone dialyzers (ISIC 3250 / NAICS 339112) is a physical manufacturing activity and is not on the ESR relevant-activity list. However, the IC must still demonstrate genuine operational substance in its operating jurisdiction — physical plant, qualified employees, board control, and bank accounts — and must not be structured as a passive IP shell receiving royalties without any real manufacturing function, which would expose it to recharacterisation as a sham in foreign tax disputes.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting a false Annual Return to VFSC, knowingly misdeclaring the absence of domestic Vanuatu business, concealing the true beneficial owner, or using the IC as a conduit to evade Vanuatu VAT and customs duties on dialysis-device supplies imported into or sold within Vanuatu. Also includes deliberately mispricing exports on Swift_LC documents to siphon profit away from the operating manufacturing entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Compulsory strike-off and revocation of the IC's registration; revocation of the Registered Agent's licence; fines up to VT 5,000,000 for regulatory fraud; additional VAT and customs penalties of up to three times the dutiable or taxable value; forfeiture of goods and freezing of funds by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, shadow directors, and controlling shareholders face personal civil restitution for unpaid duties and taxes, director disqualification orders, travel bans pending investigation, and imprisonment up to 7 years for fraudulent tax evasion and false-declaration offences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC as a letterbox vehicle with no dialyzer manufacturing plant, no payroll, no board meetings, no own-name bank account, and no real decision-taking; all profits passively accumulate while manufacturing is performed wholly by an onshore affiliate under a bare licence arrangement with no compensating risk or capital.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off under the International Companies Act (Cap 222) and loss of good standing; foreign tax authorities may recharacterise the IC as a sham, attribute its profits to the ultimate parent, and impose full tax, interest, and negligence penalties in the shareholder's residence jurisdiction; Vanuatu itself imposes no penalty tax, but the VFSC may suspend the Registered Agent and the FIU may freeze the IC's accounts pending a beneficial-ownership audit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors who sign substance declarations that are knowingly false are personally liable for reckless misrepresentation; they face disqualification from acting as directors or agents in Vanuatu, monetary fines, and civil asset-tracing claims by creditors and foreign tax authorities seeking to pierce the corporate veil.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain and file accurate beneficial-ownership records with the Registered Agent; laundering proceeds of cross-border dialysis-procurement fraud through the IC's TT_Wire and Swift_LC payment rails; transacting with sanctioned medical distributors; or failing to report suspicious transactions to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit as required under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Terrorism Financing Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Corporate fines up to VT 10,000,000 under the AML/CFT regime; freezing and confiscation of the IC's bank accounts; revocation of IC registration; prohibition from conducting financial transactions in or through Vanuatu; cancellation of any health or export permits for medical devices.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal criminal liability including imprisonment up to 15 years for money laundering, travel bans, personal confiscation orders, and disqualification; the corporate veil is routinely pierced in AML proceedings, and directors who concealed the beneficial owner are jointly and severally liable for the full value of laundered funds.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed Medical-Device Activity and Trade Misinvoicing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Manufacturing, importing, or distributing dialysis hemofilters without the required Vanuatu Business Licence (Cap 258) and Ministry of Health medical-device approval; deliberately misinvoicing polyethersulfone fibre and dialyzer export shipments on Swift_LC documentary credits to shift income or evade customs duties; or using TT_Wire transfers to disguise payments for unapproved products.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Business licence revocation; customs penalties of up to three times the shipment value; seizure and destruction of non-compliant medical devices; prohibition on future importation into Vanuatu; criminal fines for trade misinvoicing plus confiscation of the proceeds of the unlawful sales.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign falsified bills of lading, certificates of origin, or LC documents are personally liable for defrauded creditors and third-party purchasers, face travel bans and asset freezes, and may be sentenced to imprisonment up to 12 years under Vanuatu fraud and customs provisions; the corporate veil is pierced where the IC is a mere instrumentality of the controlling shareholder.
